purpose: Generate non-scoring transition diagnostics from sealed native-4K temporal 100% crops so manual reviewers can inspect the most suspicious shimmer/LOD transitions first without allowing heuristics to clear or fail a Visual Fidelity critical defect.
sourceEvidence: Assets/QA/temporal_stability_manifest.json plus the SHA-256-validated native 100% crops referenced by that manifest
metrics: small translation-compensated zero-mean luma MAE for subpixel_grazing
policy: Diagnostics may only rank exact sealed frame transitions for manual review; they do not constitute an observed visual defect by themselves.
A low diagnostic metric never proves that severe aliasing/shimmering or visible LOD pop is absent.
A high diagnostic metric creates a review candidate rather than an automatic FAIL because legitimate parallax, occlusion, vegetation motion appearance and LOD blending can change image statistics.
Reviewers must inspect the referenced sealed 100% crops at 1:1 pixel scale in frame order before recording observedTemporalRefs or clearing a critical defect.
No resampling, sharpening, frame interpolation or regenerated proxy image may substitute for the sealed crops.
